g.text: webphone seams (config-gated · OFF = byte-identical · both-or-neither everywhere)

config keys: crm.{url,token,token_file,ca_file} · paperless.{url,token} · asr.{url,token,model} · push.ntfy.* · push.fcm.credentials_file · gateway.{mode,url,webhook_secret} · auth.passkey.* · auth.oauth2.* · textagent.{url,secret}
gateway seam — loopback (dev, zero PBX) | webhook (multipart {url}/message|/fax, Bearer secret, provider_ref receipt) · SelfSendRejection (identities) · honest Content-Type parts

pbx seam — pbx.Client (directory verify fail-closed · CDR page) · /phone-api proxy (rides PhoneAPI.HTTPClient, Range passthrough) · GET /internal/directory/{ext} (xml_curl bridge, loopback+Bearer, machineSurface)

CRM seam (Kith) — crm.Resolver: names 6h/5min · context 2min/15min · cap 1024/256 · transport failures never cached · single-flight · server-to-server only (browser never talks to the CRM) · data mesh, not replica
paperless seam — inbound faxes only · fire-and-forget after persist+notify · duplicate refusal = inert success · blob store stays storage truth
ASR seam — asr.url ALONE enables · POST /api/transcribe → {url}/v1/audio/transcriptions · local-provider doctrine (GDPR) · auto-start on Established
textagent seam — review API /draft (+framed transcript, tail-cap 6000) · loopback http is the normal url shape · summarize + detached review artifact
push seam — ntfy (JSON to server root, topic in body, priority 5/3) + FCM (RS256 JWT-bearer, no SDK): two INDEPENDENT transports · ErrUnregistered prunes the device row · write-only token doctrine
chat-network seam — domain.Network (sms|signal|session|matrix) inside Address · sender registry (unregistered = Rejection) · receivers call the SAME Service.Receive
identity — passkey: userauth in-process usermgmt v4 (own usermgmt.db) · sso: Pocket ID OIDC · /login is THE front door (loginpage ExtraSection)
gates every seam (fail-closed boot on wrong halves)
